messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Follow your diet, medication, and exercise routines very closely.
Store at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light.
Triplet: ["Simvastatin", "requires", "diet"]

The relation 'requires' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug necessitates the concurrent implementation of the treatment component or measure specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in combination with': The subject drug is used together with the other treatment or lifestyle measure specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
D. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
E. 'may include': The subject treatment program or regimen can incorporate the component or intervention specified by the object entity.
